tasks.title: Host subscription secrets are validated and copied only through secrets-init
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, init-secrets and secrets-init files/behavior, D14 and matching Checks; secrets portions of Security impact. Keep generation, validation, atomic distribution and their tests together before any overlay consumes them. init-secrets creates distinct subscriptions-token and subscriptions-key as 64 lowercase hex plus one newline, mode 0600, keeps existing files and never prints values. PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS unset/off adds no output; on in files mode reads/validates both host inputs via readHostFile and requires distinctness from each other and every token/key read in that run, including console key and all probe-location tokens. Require mounted /out/status and /out/notify directories. Validate ALL inputs before the FIRST write (including the existing api/probe writes), then use writeSecret for /out/status/subscriptions-token, /out/notify/subscriptions-token and /out/notify/subscriptions-key with 0400 and 1000:1000. Invalid switch values and on in generate mode fail with the section's exact fixed rule lines. Extend test fixtures/output mount helpers for new consumers, preserve every existing files/generate flow and symlink guarantee, and update README's secrets model. No setup enables subscriptions here.

acceptance.expected: exit 0. Each of the 2 new files is a regular 0600 file containing exactly 64 lowercase hex and one newline (65 bytes); both differ from each other and every other generated secret. Rerun preserves existing content and independently creates a missing file. No value appears in stdout/stderr and planted symlinks are not followed.

exit 0. With on and valid files, exactly the 3 new output files have mode 0400 and owner 1000:1000 with fixture content. Missing input, 63-character/uppercase value, equal new secrets, equality with probe/admin/console key and a missing output directory fail before writing any existing or new output. Missing /out/status reports /out/status: is not mounted (same rule for notify); bad secret reports the file and 64-lowercase-hex/distinctness rule. Unset/off creates 0 new output files. Invalid value reports PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS: must be on or off; generate+on reports PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS: files mode only. No output contains a secret, and existing files/generate/symlink/error-path tests stay green.

tasks.title: Compose E2E checks real subscriber mail and CI requires the subscription success line
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all remaining Files/Behavior, every e2e/subscriptions.sh step 1-14, overlay/static-check/CI/docs requirements, all Checks and Completion evidence; Rollout order and Acceptance evidence 4-5; applicable Security impact. Keep overlay, scenario, parsing/static tests, setup rules and CI gate together so no committed intermediate setup references missing artifacts. After status/notify merge, extend the existing dev e2e path only with this scenario between Console probe locations and Persistence. Use the test-only three-file Compose merge locally in the scenario, the centrally pinned common mailpit service, loopback API/UI port 8025, new secrets volumes and every literal environment/mount/dependency in the section; never turn the feature on in regular setups or publish 9300. Add e2e-subs/e2e-dev-subs port tables and run all static rules for both; preserve dev-image acceptance for the new dev combination and reject mailpit on 0.0.0.0 under rule 5. The scenario reads real mailpit messages with literal addresses/markers, the exact settle barrier S1-S5, bounded T_* waits and literal HTTP/mail counts. Before each incident step capture incident success/failure counts; immediately after the last successful API write capture d0=subscriber_detections_total. Wait for detections>=d0+2, then events_pending=0, assert the success delta equals that step's literal sent count and failures did not grow. Wait for expected mail, read negative counts, then wait one further detection and pending=0 and read them again. Neither another recipient's mail nor a later incident's mail establishes absence; fan-out id order is random and multiple incidents can share a poll. Steps 6/7/8/10/11 use sent=6/2/4/1/1 respectively; no P3 barrier exists. Restart notify only after step 10 settle completes, then reread all before counters after restart because process counters reset. Add fixed-metric replay tests of settle itself. Restore the ordinary two-file status/notify services and remove mailpit/open incidents on completion, keeping inherited outer teardown safe. Full published-image mode prints exactly skip: email subscriptions (published images); dev must finish with ok: email subscriptions. Add the parsing/Compose test to lint and an anchored success-line requirement to e2e-dev beside existing requirements. Docs cover both secrets/switch, port table/scenario and the full operator override with real SMTP/TLS/password secret, matching public URLs, backup risks and no console subscriber list.

acceptance.expected: exit 0. Fixed independent mailpit answer fixtures prove message counting, single-To inspection, plain-text/link token extraction and private-marker searches without deriving expected values from the scenario. Both full+e2e+subscriptions and dev+e2e+subscriptions render with docker compose config --quiet; mailpit reuses the common pin, 8025 is loopback-only and 9300 has 0 published ports. Fixed independent metric texts drive the real settle helper with a fake reader: detections growing by only 1 after the write fails; events_pending staying 1 fails; success delta 2 when expected 1 fails; any failure-counter growth fails. A replay meeting S2-S4 and two negative reads of exactly 0 separated by one further committed detection and pending=0 passes. Timeouts fail with observed metric values only, no addresses/tokens. Helper fixtures never calculate expected counts from implementation/scenario output.
